add.title: A routed child page (Doc api/<name>/, ClassDoc methods/<name>/) should not fetch its own page.jsonl
add.why: Each one asks for <url>page.jsonl, which never exists for a route-built page, and logs a same-origin 404 (seen on /framework/core/View/api/append/ and /framework/core/Item/methods/set/, worktree class-docs, 2026-10-28). Smoke counts a same-origin 404 as a FAIL.

add.title: Item tool: build a page.jsonl's root from the class its line 1 names
add.why: page_tools.js class_of() reads line 1's "class" ("./LivePage.js") but class_for() only knows Page and the Task family, so the tool replays /live/ as a plain Page: its instructions list Page's methods, not LivePage's, and page_read shows method keys (toggle, flash, press) as stored data. Needs the page class to import in node (LivePage imports /app.js today) and a Servex restart. Found 2026-11-06, task mastermind-live-page.

add.title: Stream page.jsonl to a tab that is not on localhost (phone on LAN or tunnel)
add.why: Reader.dev and the dev socket are localhost-only (an RCE guard), so a page.jsonl page on the phone loads once and never updates; /live/ v1 worked around it with its own Range-poll Tail. The fix belongs in core (a read-only stream, e.g. SSE from Servex, or the Range tail moved into Page/Reader.js), not per page. Taps there also cannot save: /api/item is loopback only. Found 2026-11-06, task mastermind-live-page.

add.title: Item tool: a `read: "a.b.c"` param that answers a dotted path and never writes
add.why: Agents cannot read one part of a page: {"get":"content"} was appended to /live/page.jsonl as a line (get is a Page method, so the check passed) and answered nothing. Proposal (2026-11-06, sent to voice-app): item({path, read}) resolves with get(); JSON capped about 4 KB; a list as {id, type, title} rows plus a total to drill into; a missing path names the ids that exist. Also refuse a delta keyed by a read-only method (get, find, toJSON, walk, root). Needs a Servex restart.

add.title: Page namespace: group Page's ~150 methods into on-demand sub-objects (page.columns, page.previews, page.tabs, page.log, page.links) and drop the ~50 forwarders
add.why: Page mashes ~150 methods into one namespace (Page 97 + Item 30 + Events 5); about 50 are one-line forwarders left by the 2026-10-12 split into Columns/Previews/Jsonl/Links/Prefs helpers. A reader cannot tell API from plumbing, a delta key can call plumbing by accident, and Page.add (sub-page) shadows the list verb add (card). Proposal (waits for the owner's yes): doc/namespaces.md. Help for voice stays the 9 page verbs + the content list; a group's verbs print on demand.

add.title: Frame.js: make navigation "columns" draw columns
add.why: Frame.js render() (lines 8-30) has branches for rail, tabs and expand but none for "columns", so {"navigation":"columns"} sets a word nothing reads. Proven at /live/demos/columns-page/ (public/live/doc/page-features.md). Smallest fix: one branch calling page.columns(). Held because the page.ui prototype (/live/design/) may move columns off Page.

add.title: Page.child: load a jsonl child with this.constructor as host (this.constructor.jsonl)
add.why: LivePage.child copies Page.child's jsonl branch (Page.class.js:382) only to pass LivePage as host; a host-aware Page.child lets live-page drop the copy (mastermind-live-page, merge 28134835e).

add.title: Make the md view open a .md file inside a session folder (e.g. /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/dictation-v3/md/handover/)
add.why: A readme link to a session folder's .md file renders as <folder>/md/<name>/, which 404s (App.load: nothing matches). The same route works in module folders (/framework/ext/Chat/md/readme/). Found 2026-11-06 because it failed the merge smoke for every page linking it; ux/Dictate/readme.md now links the folder instead.
